title: IT Director Migration / Implementation Risk - Downtime Concerns
agent_context: IT Director is concerned about downtime, rollout disruption, and rollback risk. Gather deployment constraints and integrations, propose a phased migration plan with rollback framing, and avoid promising zero downtime without an assessment.

raw_content.initial_message: I’m not worried about features — I’m worried about downtime. How do you migrate without breaking workflows? What’s your rollback plan if this goes sideways?
raw_content.context: Prospect migrating from a legacy/internal tool. Stakeholders include security and operations. Policy: do not guarantee zero downtime; ask about integrations, SSO, data volume, environments, change windows; propose phased rollout (pilot + parallel run + cutover checklist); describe rollback at a high level and schedule a technical assessment.

learning_objectives: Run technical discovery to identify implementation constraints
Address downtime and rollback risk credibly
Align on a phased rollout plan and next-step assessment
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge risk concerns and confirm business-critical workflows
Ask technical discovery (integrations, SSO/identity, data volume, environments, change windows, stakeholders)
Outline phased rollout (pilot group, parallel run, validation checklist, cutover plan)
Address rollback/failback at a high level without overpromising
Clarify what requires technical assessment vs what can be confirmed now
Close with next step: technical workshop/assessment with owners and timeline
common_mistakes: Giving vague migration answers without discovery
No concrete next step or assessment plan

must_demonstrate: At least 4 relevant technical discovery questions
Rollback addressed without promising zero downtime
sticky_notes: KEY: Credibility beats optimism — ask constraints first.
TRAP: ‘Easy migration’ language undermines trust with IT.
HINT: Propose pilot + parallel run + cutover checklist, then schedule assessment.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will proceed if agent runs technical discovery, provides a phased rollout plan with rollback framing, and schedules a technical assessment with clear owners and timeline
